articles.title: US suspends arms deliveries to Estonia, Finland's situation unclear
articles.summary: The US has suspended arms deliveries to Estonia, a decision communicated by US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth to Estonian Defence Minister Hanno Pevkur. This development, reported by ERR, signals a significant shift in defence cooperation between the two NATO allies, impacting Estonia's military procurement and strategic planning.

articles.title: Pahalgam anniversary: How the 2025 terror attack triggered Rs 3 lakh crore defence boom and 3 multibagger stocks
articles.summary: One year ago, Pakistan-based Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) massacred 26 people in Kashmir's Pahalgam. India responded swiftly with 'Operation Sindoor,' deploying military assets. This incident underscores persistent cross-border terrorism challenges and India's robust security measures to protect national integrity, highlighting ongoing efforts to counter militant groups operating from across the border.

articles.title: Chinese navy brushes past Okinawa islands as tensions with Japan flare
articles.summary: Chinese naval vessels, including a destroyer, transited a waterway between Japanese-administered Okinawa islands. Beijing stated the group was returning from an exercise, passing through international waters. This regular activity, while asserting freedom of navigation, often heightens regional vigilance and underscores the military presence in the East China Sea, relevant for SSB aspirants studying Indo-Pacific security dynamics.

articles.title: Ukraine says some Russian missiles fly near Chornobyl, risking major accident
articles.summary: Russia has repeatedly launched drones and missiles near Ukraine's disused Chornobyl nuclear plant, significantly elevating the risk of a major accident. Ukraine's top officials warn these flight paths pose a severe threat to regional and international safety, highlighting the unpredictable dangers of conflict near critical civilian infrastructure. This situation demands urgent global attention due to potential catastrophic consequences.

articles.title: India will never forget, terror will be met with strength: Rajnath Singh pays tribute to victims of Pahalgam terror attack
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh paid tribute to victims of the Pahalgam terror attack, reaffirming India's "firm, decisive, and unwavering" response to terrorism. This statement underscores the nation's unwavering resolve in combating security threats. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the government's strong stance on national security and commitment to eradicating terrorism, a crucial aspect of India's defence policy.

articles.title: "For acts against India, response is assured," says Indian Army on Pahalgam attack anniversary; recalls Op Sindoor
articles.summary: The Indian Army marked the one-year anniversary of the deadly Pahalgam terror attack, which claimed 26 lives. Reaffirming its unwavering resolve against terrorism, the Army emphasized decisive military action. This commemoration underscores India's steadfast commitment to national security and its proactive stance in combating terror threats, crucial for regional stability and peace.

articles.title: Gujarat: Indian Army's Air Defence regiment showcases L70 guns to mark first anniversary of Operation Sindoor
articles.summary: As India approaches Operation Sindoor's first anniversary, the Indian Army's Air Defence regiment in Bhuj showcased its L70 air defence guns. This display underscored the regiment's critical role in national security, highlighting the L70s as symbols of vigilance, precision, and unwavering readiness. For SSB aspirants, it exemplifies the Army's continuous commitment to modernizing its capabilities and ensuring robust protection of Indian airspace.

articles.title: Here’s Where the National Fight Over Gerrymandered Maps Stands
articles.summary: The New York Times reports on the current state of the national battle over gerrymandered electoral maps. This ongoing political and legal fight concerns the manipulation of voting district boundaries to unfairly favor political parties. The article likely details developments across states, highlighting challenges in ensuring fair representation and democratic integrity nationwide.

articles.title: HBO’s New 8-Part Sci-Fi Western Will Be ‘True Detective Meets Watchmen’
articles.summary: HBO is developing an ambitious new sci-fi western series, attracting significant attention. Additionally, upcoming DC shows are generating buzz by aiming to blend the critically acclaimed styles of 'True Detective' and 'Watchmen'. This signals a potential shift in quality for comic book adaptations, striving to overcome the challenge of standing out in a crowded entertainment landscape and captivating viewers with sophisticated storytelling.
